model_annotations.English: The pie chart represents the distribution of a certain quantity across three different years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. It contains three slices, each labeled with the year it represents and the corresponding percentage or count. The largest slice is blue and represents the year 2019 with 46% of the total. The second-largest slice is red and represents the year 2018 with 33%. The smallest slice is green and represents the year 2017 with 21%. The percentages are shown inside the slices, and each slice is proportionally sized to its percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and there is no indication of any slices being visually emphasized or any specific ordering beyond the size of the slices, which follows a descending pattern from 2019 to 2017.
model_annotations.German: Das dreisegmentarierte Kreisdiagramm stellt das Anteil eines spezifischen Metrik bei drei verschiedenen Datenpunkten dar: 2017, 2018 und 2019. Es gibt ein Gesamtsemelement anders als die Segmentbevölkerung. Von niedrig zu hoch sind die Drittel für das Jahr 2017, 2018 und 2019 21%, 33% und 46% (entsprechend einer Population von 21, 33 und 46 - sichtbar begrenzt).
